ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In the winter of 2010, affected by expectations such as South Korea's "kimchi crisis", the price of Chinese cabbage in Shandong rose sharply. However, since September 2011, the price of Chinese cabbage in Shandong has continued to fall, and no one wanted it even at 5 fen per jin. From "expensive vegetables hurt the people" to "cheap vegetables hurt farmers", it aroused widespread concern in society. Read the "sketch map of a vegetable-growing area in Shandong Province". <image1> This place has built multiple kimchi processing factories; this type of factory belongs to which kind of industrial orientation type?

matched_variant_raw.title: Dataset Open Question
matched_variant_raw.rewritten_question_text:
In the winter of 2010, affected by expectations such as South Korea's "kimchi crisis," the price of Chinese cabbage in Shandong rose sharply. However, since September 2011, the price of Chinese cabbage in Shandong has continued to fall, and no one wanted it even at 5 fen per jin. From "expensive vegetables hurt the people" to "cheap vegetables hurt farmers," this aroused widespread concern in society. Read the "sketch map of a vegetable-growing area in Shandong Province."

<image1>

Several kimchi processing plants have been built in this place. Which type of industrial orientation does this kind of factory belong to?

The question stem states that this is a vegetable-growing area in Shandong Province, and that several kimchi processing plants have been built locally. Then reason: The main raw materials for kimchi processing are fresh cabbage and other vegetables. Chinese cabbage is large in volume, high in water content, and easy to rot; if transported over a long distance, it will increase transportation costs and losses. Therefore, kimchi processing plants are suitable to be located near vegetable-producing areas; their dominant location factor is being close to the place of origin of raw materials, so they belong to raw-material-oriented industry.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有城区、公路、河流，周围为丘陵和平原，题干说明这是山东某蔬菜种植地区。再读题干：当地大白菜供应量大，并建有多个泡菜加工厂。泡菜加工的主要原料是新鲜白菜等蔬菜，原料体积大、易腐烂，远距离运输成本和损耗较高。因此工厂布局在蔬菜产地附近，主导因素是接近原料，判定为原料指向型工业。

raw_record.original_question:
2010年冬，受韩国“泡菜危机”等预期的影响，山东大白菜价格暴涨。然而，2011年9月以来，山东大白菜价格持续回落，5分钱一斤都没人要。从“菜贵伤民”到“菜贱伤农”，引起了社会的广泛关注。读“山东省某蔬菜种植地区略图”。

<image1>

该地建有多个泡菜加工厂，该类工厂属于哪一种工业指向类型？
